response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff Software Engineer with strong distributed systems expertise and some recent exposure to AI agent infrastructure. However, he fundamentally lacks the executive leadership experience required for a CTO position. There is no evidence of him scaling engineering teams from 10 to 30+ people, managing a technical leadership layer, or architecting complex, regulated AI-native fintech systems at an enterprise scale.
strengths: Over 15 years of hands-on software engineering experience with deep backend and distributed systems expertise.
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
Proven ability to build high-throughput microservices, including systems handling millions of requests per second.
concerns: Complete lack of executive-level leadership experience or history of scaling engineering organizations.
AI experience appears to be recent and tooling-focused rather than architecting stateful, production-grade multi-agent systems.
Missing deep fintech infrastructure expertise in areas like credit-risk assessment, algorithmic working-capital allocation, and compliance.
